name: @adsaver-labs/wix-studio-ui-cli
description: Safe local CLI scaffold for inspecting and carefully controlling Wix Studio Editor UI through a user-owned browser session.

scripts.check: node --check bin/wix-studio-ui-cli.mjs && for f in src/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done
scripts.smoke: node bin/wix-studio-ui-cli.mjs --help && node bin/wix-studio-ui-cli.mjs inspect --dry-run && node bin/wix-studio-ui-cli.mjs diagnostics --dry-run && node bin/wix-studio-ui-cli.mjs verification --dry-run

author: AdSaver Labs
